geo.title: Country-targeted pull
geo.diNote: Each DataImpulse product has its own login and password, so the product is chosen by the credentials you enter above. Pick the matching name here and the pulled proxies are labelled with it, which keeps several products apart in the pool.
geo.anyipApiNote: Two ways to connect: paste your proxy Username + Password below (anyip dashboard → Get Proxy Details), OR enter an API key + Team ID here to auto-provision a proxy account. The API key is NOT the proxy password.
geo.gatewayHint: Pre-filled for the Long-Acting ISP plan (isp.smartproxy.net:3100). If your smartproxy.org dashboard → Proxy Setup shows a different host:port, paste it here to override.
geo.apiUrlLabel: API URL - required, from your dashboard
geo.apiUrlHintBefore: Paste the URL from your ShopSocks5 dashboard → SOCKS5 API guide. It already contains your token. Put
geo.apiUrlHintAfter: where the country code belongs to filter by the selection above.
geo.diStickyHelp: One proxy per profile. Each one keeps its own exit IP for the time you pick below.
geo.diRotatingHelp: One shared endpoint whose exit IP changes on every request. It adds a single proxy, so it suits scraping rather than logged-in profiles.
geo.diLookupHint: Loading shows how many live IPs each state or city has, as suggestions in the fields above. Separate several values with commas.
geo.diNeedCreds: Enter the plan login and password first.
geo.howManyListTitle: How many of the proxies on your account to import. Leave blank for all.
geo.gatewayHintGeneric: Pre-filled with the {{provider}} default gateway ({{gateway}}). Change it only if your {{provider}} dashboard gives you a different host or port.
geo.gatewayHintNone: Paste the gateway host shown in your {{provider}} dashboard; the port is filled in for you when it is standard.
geo.howManyCapTitle: How many proxies to add. Each provider has its own maximum per pull (usually 100).

rotating.bdpmDesc: Select only when utilizing a Bright Data BDPM proxy configuration path.
rotating.tip: Tip: a rotating gateway uses the same host:port for every session - your username/password (or sticky-session token) selects the exit IP.

apiSync.title: API Sync
apiSync.brightDataHelp: Pulls the zone's routable IPs via {{provider}}'s API and pins each to the super-proxy gateway using the username & password above.
apiSync.verifyAfter: above against the {{provider}} gateway with a live request, then adds the working endpoint.
apiSync.ipv6Help: Appends -ipversion-6 to the username. If the target site publishes no AAAA record, Oxylabs falls back to IPv4 automatically, so an IPv6 pull does not guarantee an IPv6 exit. May need enabling on your Oxylabs account first.

geoHints.apify: Apify residential routes through one gateway (proxy.apify.com:8000); the country and a sticky session are encoded into the username. Each pull mints that many sticky residential IPs you can assign to profiles. Use the password from Apify Console → Proxy → HTTP settings.
geoHints.smartproxyorg: Smartproxy.org (Long-Acting ISP) routes through isp.smartproxy.net:3100 and embeds area (country) + optional state/city + a sticky lifetime/session into the proxy username. Enter your sub-account username (smart-…) and its password. "Keep same IP" sets how long one exit IP stays fixed (5 min up to 24 h); leave it on "Different each time" with a blank session to mint several rotating IPs. If your dashboard shows a different host:port, override it below.
geoHints.shopsocks5: ShopSocks5 pulls your purchased SOCKS5 (or HTTPS) list via its API, filtered to the chosen country/state/city. The API authenticates with your account username/email + API token TOGETHER - token alone returns “User or Api Token incorrect”. Pick the Plan that matches your subscription (Premium / List / Daily).
geoHints.anyip: anyip.io routes through one gateway (portal.anyip.io:1080) and encodes the pool type (Residential/Mobile), country, an optional sticky-session name and lifetime into the proxy username. Connect either by pasting your proxy Username (user_…) + Password from the dashboard, OR by entering an API key + Team ID to auto-provision an account. A blank session with “Different each time” mints rotating IPs; a fixed session name pins one IP. Override the gateway if your dashboard shows a custom port.
geoHints.dataimpulse: Every pull adds new proxies. Sticky proxies sit on their own ports, so asking for 5 when the pool already holds 5 with the same settings adds the next 5 ports instead of returning the same ones. Use the login and password of one DataImpulse product, shown on that product page in the dashboard.
geoHints.proxyseller: Residential is a traffic package: each New list pull creates a list on your account named SoftGlaze plus the location and time, with up to 1000 ports, and each port is its own exit IP. IPv6, IPv4, ISP and Mobile are sold per IP: the pull adds the addresses you already own, each on its own port, and needs nothing created.
geoHints.iproyal: IPRoyal builds each proxy for you: the location and a sticky session go into the password, on its gateway geo.iproyal.com. Sticky proxies share one host and port, and each keeps its own exit IP for the lifetime you pick. Traffic comes out of your residential balance or the chosen sub-user.
geoHints.packetstream: PacketStream routes through one gateway (proxy.packetstream.io:31112 HTTP, :31113 SOCKS5). Enter the Username and Proxy Password from the dashboard Network Access page (the password is not your account password). Pick a country to target it, or leave it on any. Leave Sticky session blank for a fresh rotating IP; type a session name to mint that many sticky exit IPs (one per profile). Traffic comes out of your PacketStream balance.
geoHints.airproxy: Airproxy sells dedicated mobile proxies (each its own SIM), so the app lists what is already on your account. Paste your API key (dashboard, API section) and pull. How many caps the import (blank = all). The country is fixed by the SIM, so there is nothing to target. Each proxy is HTTP. Rotate the IP from the Airproxy dashboard.
geoHints.catproxies: CatProxies uses your API key (My Account → API Keys, starts with cp_) plus the Plan ID of one plan from Active Plans. Pick Standard Residential or Rotating Mobile to match that plan. Choose a country, or leave it Worldwide; Residential also takes a state and city, Mobile a city. How many above 1 mints that many sticky IPs (Keep same IP sets how long each holds); type a session name to choose their names. Residential is HTTP or SOCKS5; mobile is HTTP only. Traffic comes out of that plan's bandwidth.
geoHints.rapidproxy: RapidProxy has no management API, so the app builds the proxies on its gateway (us.rapidproxy.io:5001, HTTP). Enter a sub-account username and password from the dashboard (Residential, sub-accounts; give it a traffic cap above 0). Pick a country or leave it on any; State and City are optional, and City needs a State. Leave Sticky session blank for a new IP on every request; type a session name to mint that many sticky IPs, and Keep same IP sets how long each holds (up to 180 minutes). Change the gateway host if your dashboard shows another server.
geoHints.novada: NOVADA builds each proxy on its gateway (super.novada.pro:7777, HTTP). Enter a proxy user created under Residential Proxies, Users (your login email does not work) and its password. Pick Residential, Rotating ISP or Mobile to match your plan, then a country; State and City are optional. Leave Sticky session blank for a new IP on every request; type a session name to mint that many sticky IPs, and Keep same IP sets how long each holds (up to 120 minutes). If the dashboard endpoint generator shows a regional host such as pr-as.novada.pro, enter it as the gateway.
geoHints.proxiessx: Proxies.sx uses your API key (it needs the account:read scope) to read your gateway login and proxy password, then builds proxies on gw.proxies.sx:7000. Pick Mobile or Residential and a country; a country is required, and if it has no stock the proxy fails rather than exiting from another country. Leave Sticky session blank for a new IP on each connection; type a session name to mint that many sticky IPs. To rotate a sticky IP, pull again with a new session name. Set a proxy password in the Proxies.sx dashboard first.
geoHints.mobileproxyspace: MobileProxy.Space sells dedicated mobile proxies, so the app lists what is already on your account. Paste your API token from the personal account and choose HTTP or SOCKS5. How many caps the import (blank = all). The country is fixed by each proxy, so there is nothing to target. Change the IP with the proxy's change-IP link in the MobileProxy.Space dashboard. Their API allows one identical request every few seconds, so wait a moment between pulls.
geoHints.proxysolutions: Proxy-Solutions lists the proxies already on your account. Paste the Integration token from the dashboard, API for developers page (the third box, not the API key above it) and choose HTTP or SOCKS5. Pick a country to import only the proxies in that country, and use How many to cap the import (blank = all). Expired proxies are skipped, and each proxy keeps the country and name it has in your account.
geoHints.proxmint: Proxmint uses a read-only API key (Settings, API keys, starts with pmk_). The app reads your product's gateway and login from it, so nothing else is needed. Pick the product you bought, a country (leave Any for worldwide) and optionally a state or a city; when both are set the city is used. How many above 1 mints that many sticky IPs, each held for the Keep same IP time (1 to 120 minutes); type a session name to choose their names. HTTP uses port 823, SOCKS5 port 824. The key cannot buy anything or change settings.
geoHints.databay: Databay uses a proxy user, not your login email: dashboard, Proxy Users, copy the username and its password. Everything runs on gw.databay.co:8888, which carries HTTP and SOCKS5 on the same port. Pick Residential, Mobile or Datacenter, a country, and on Residential optionally a state or city (the most specific one is used). How many above 1 mints that many sticky IPs held for the Keep same IP time (up to 120 minutes).
geoHints.froxy: Froxy: open your subscription (My Subscriptions, Manage) and copy the Login and Password from Login/Password Access. Pick the Pool type that matches that subscription (Residential, Mobile or Datacenter); each Froxy subscription has its own login, so use the Mobile subscription's login for Mobile. Choose a country and optionally a region or city. Each proxy gets its own port from 9000 upwards, and each port is a separate exit IP. If your subscription uses an IP whitelist, add this computer's IP in the Froxy dashboard or the proxies are refused.
geoHints.nodemaven: NodeMaven builds every proxy on gate.nodemaven.com (8080 HTTP, 1080 SOCKS5). Enter the proxy username and password from the dashboard, Proxy Setup (not the account API key). Pick Residential or Mobile, a country and optionally a state or city. How many above 1 mints that many sticky IPs, each held for the Keep same IP time.
geoHints.marsproxies: MarsProxies uses your API token (Dashboard, Settings, API; it unlocks after 1 GB of residential traffic) to generate a residential proxy list for your sub-user. Enter the token plus the sub-user username and password, pick a country and optionally a state or city. Proxies are sticky by default so each profile keeps its exit IP. Residential only.
geoHints.proxidize: Proxidize uses your API token (app.proxidize.com, Settings, API Token). For a Per-Proxy plan, also enter the proxy username and the app lists that plan's ready proxies. For a Per-GB plan, leave the username empty and paste the gateway host from Proxy Details; the app builds sticky proxies on ports 20000 (HTTP) and 20002 (SOCKS5).
geoHints.ipfoxy: IPFoxy builds every proxy on its rotating residential gateway (gate-us.ipfoxy.io:58688 for the Americas; use gate-sg.ipfoxy.io for Asia-Pacific). Enter the proxy account and password from the dashboard; the app adds customer- if it is missing. Pick a country and optionally a state and city. How many above 1 mints that many sticky IPs, each held for the Keep same IP time. HTTP and SOCKS5 share the same port.
geoHints.kookeey: kookeey: enter the username as your user ID and security policy username joined by a hyphen (for example 123456789-abcdef) and the security policy password. The country, state, city and sticky session go into the password, the way kookeey's docs describe. Leave the country on Any for a global exit. How many above 1 mints that many sticky IPs (8-character sessions), each rotated after the Keep same IP time. Use a regional gateway such as gate-us.kookeey.info if you prefer.
geoHints.mangoproxy: MangoProxy uses your API key to generate ready proxy lines. Enter the key and, optionally, the proxy sub-account username (blank uses the first sub-account on your account). Pick Residential, Residential light, Datacenter or ISP, a country and optionally a state or city, HTTP or SOCKS5, and how many (up to 100). Keep same IP sets the sticky session time (up to 120 minutes).

notConnected.body: {{provider}} does not support automatic pull yet. Enter the gateway details from your {{provider}} dashboard below to add its proxies manually.
notConnected.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted on this machine, ready for a direct connector.

ps.pickList: Pick one of your saved lists, or switch to New list.
ps.keyPlaceholder: Paste the key from Dashboard, API
ps.keyHint: The key is in your Proxy-Seller dashboard under API. If you limited it to certain IP addresses, add this computer's IP there as well. It is stored encrypted on this machine.
ps.noListsYet: Check account to load your lists
ps.existingHint: Downloads every port of that list. Pulling the same list again only adds ports the pool does not have yet.
ps.portsTitle: Ports in the new list, 1 to 1000. Each port is its own exit IP.
ps.geoHint: Region and city names are case sensitive, so pick them from the loaded lists rather than typing them.
ps.stickyHelp: Each port keeps its exit IP for as long as that device stays online. Best for logged-in profiles.
ps.perRequestHelp: Each port gets a new exit IP on every request. Suits scraping, not logged-in profiles.
ps.intervalHelp: Each port changes its exit IP on the timer you pick.
ps.checkForOrders: All orders (Check account to see counts)
ps.orderHint: Adds every active IP in the order, each on its own port. Pulling again only adds IPs the pool does not have yet.
ps.ipv6Note: IPv6 exits can only reach websites that have an IPv6 address. Before assigning these to profiles, check that the sites you use support IPv6, or a page may fail to load through them.

account.noResidential: No residential package on this account.

ipr.keyPlaceholder: Paste the token from Dashboard, Settings, API
ipr.keyHint: The token is in the IPRoyal dashboard under Settings, API. It is stored encrypted on this machine.
ipr.useOwnCreds: Use a proxy username and password instead
ipr.subuserHint: A sub-user draws traffic from its own balance. Its password stays on IPRoyal; the app only sends its id.
ipr.noSubusers: Check account to list your sub-users, or enter the proxy username and password below.
ipr.stickyHelp: Each proxy gets its own session and keeps its exit IP for the time you pick below. Every pull adds new sessions.
ipr.geoHint: The lists come from your IPRoyal account, so they only show locations your plan can use.
